name: Kettlebell swing
steps: Stand with feet a little wider than your hips, the kettlebell on the floor just in front of you.
Hinge at the hips, grab the handle with both hands and hike the bell back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward to swing the bell to chest height, arms straight and relaxed.
Let it fall back between your legs, hinging again, and go straight into the next rep.
tips: Snap the hips, arms just guide the bell.
